'''Spawning Day''' was a holiday celebrated by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bingo Mehndra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. On one occasion, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] sent the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] to perform there.
